statement: Revit 2027 includes an AI assistant (technical preview) that answers questions and acts on the model through tools exposed by an MCP interface.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Autodesk Assistant (Tech Preview)

superiority: Run assistant actions as reviewable, undoable command batches with a visible plan before execution.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A natural-language request to list levels returns the project's level names.

statement: Ask the assistant for model information such as element counts, parameters and room areas.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Assistant: Model Queries

superiority: Answers cite the elements and queries used so they can be verified.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Returned counts equal the schedule counts on a seeded model.

statement: Ask the assistant to change parameters or create elements through tool calls.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Assistant: Model Edits

superiority: Preview every edit as a diff with per-edit approval.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Requested parameter change is applied to the right elements and can be undone.

statement: AI suggests and places typical room elements (fixtures, furniture, devices) from room context.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Autocomplete Room Elements

superiority: Suggestions rank with reasons and respect clearances and code rules.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Suggested set for a bathroom contains the expected fixture types.

statement: AI-assisted placement of tags and dimensions to reduce overlaps and clutter.
superiority: Deterministic layout engine with explainable constraints.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Tag overlap count falls on a sample view versus manual placement.

statement: AI-assisted creation of sheets, views and annotations from the model (announced under project intelligence).
superiority: Rule-based and reviewable generation with a repeatable result.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A sheet set generated for a sample house includes plans, sections and schedules.

statement: Expose Revit operations to external agents through the Model Context Protocol.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: MCP Server for Revit

superiority: Provide an open MCP server with scoped permissions and audit log.
notes: Acceptance sketch: An external client lists tools and runs a read-only query.

statement: Keep AI changes inside transactions with preview and rollback and a log of prompts and actions.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: AI Safety and Review

superiority: Provide full provenance for each AI action in the history.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Rolling back an AI change restores the earlier state exactly.
